audience.detail: App has sign-up/login and sharing plus paid premium recipes, so it looks built for customers or the public, not staff-only.

assessment.data_detail: Collects emails, passwords and recipes and plans to take payments for premium recipes.

deployment.detail: No deploy config or CI found and frontend calls http://localhost:4000, so it cannot run in production yet.

assessment.headline: Recipe-sharing app with payments is not ready to ship due to exposed secrets and major security gaps.

issues.ai_prompt: In src/App.jsx remove hardcoded STRIPE_KEY and MAPS_KEY. Load Stripe publishable key from env and move all secret API calls to server/index.js backend. Never put secret keys in frontend code.
issues.explain: Secret payment and maps keys are written directly in frontend code where anyone can see and reuse them.
issues.recommendation: Remove keys from frontend, use server-side env variables and restrict keys in Stripe/Google dashboards.
issues.title: Secret keys exposed in frontend

issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js fix all db.query calls to use parameterized queries like $1, $2 instead of string concatenation for email, search and id params.
issues.evidence: server/index.js: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + req.body.email + "'"
issues.explain: Login, search and admin delete build database queries from user input, letting attackers steal or delete data.
issues.recommendation: Rewrite all queries with placeholders and add input validation.
issues.title: Database open to injection attacks

issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js stop logging passwords and stop comparing plain-text passwords. Add bcrypt password hashing on signup and bcrypt.compare on login, and remove console.log of credentials.
issues.explain: Passwords appear to be logged and checked as plain text, so a leak exposes all user passwords.
issues.recommendation: Hash passwords with bcrypt, never log them, and force a password reset.
issues.title: Passwords logged and not protected

issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js add authentication and admin-role check to DELETE /api/admin/users/:id, use a proper session token stored securely, and validate id as a number.
issues.explain: Anyone on the internet can delete any user with no login check on the admin route.
issues.recommendation: Require login plus admin role for admin routes and test with logged-out request.
issues.title: Anyone can delete any user

issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js replace postgres connection string with process.env.DATABASE_URL, remove hardcoded admin password, and set .env to be git-ignored and never committed.
issues.explain: Production database password is hardcoded in code and will leak if code is shared.
issues.recommendation: Move DB URL to env secrets manager and rotate the exposed password now.
issues.title: Database password hardcoded in code

issues.ai_prompt: In src/App.jsx stop using dangerouslySetInnerHTML for r.description. Render as text or sanitize with DOMPurify before rendering.
issues.explain: Showing recipe text as raw HTML lets an attacker inject scripts that steal other users sessions.
issues.recommendation: Render descriptions as plain text or clean them with a sanitizer library.
issues.title: User content can run scripts

issues.ai_prompt: Add a Privacy Policy and Terms page covering accounts, recipes and Stripe payments, link them in src/App.jsx footer, and add them before any public launch or app store listing.
issues.explain: External app collects logins and takes payments but has no privacy or terms pages.
issues.recommendation: Add privacy policy and terms, plus Stripe checkout terms and data deletion contact.
issues.title: Missing privacy policy and terms

issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js change cors({ origin: "*", credentials: true }) to allow only your frontend domain, and in src/App.jsx change fetch http://localhost:4000 to process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL with HTTPS production URL.
issues.explain: Server accepts requests from any site and frontend only works on localhost, so production is broken and unsafe.
issues.recommendation: Lock CORS to your domain, use HTTPS API URL from env, and add deploy config.
issues.title: No production hosting setup

issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js change error handler res.status(500).send(err.stack) to log err.stack server-side only and send a generic message like res.status(500).send("Something went wrong").
issues.explain: Server sends full error details to users, leaking code and database info to attackers.
issues.recommendation: Send generic error to client and log details only on server.
issues.title: Server leaks error details

issues.ai_prompt: Add a LICENSE file at project root, e.g. MIT if you want others to reuse it or Proprietary if closed, and update package.json with license field.
issues.explain: No LICENSE file means no one else may legally use the code and stores/clients often require one.
issues.recommendation: Pick and add a LICENSE file before sharing or selling.
issues.title: No licence file present

license.detail: No LICENSE file and no licence declared in package.json was found.

mobile.detail: No mobile signals found; code is React web plus Express backend only.

strengths: Simple React + Express + Postgres stack is easy to fix and deploy
No third-party media or fonts to license
Very small codebase so security fixes are quick
assessment.summary: Recipe Box is a web app to save, search and share recipes with planned paid premium recipes via Stripe. It has web frontend and Express API with login and Postgres storage for external users. It cannot ship yet with exposed secrets, injection and access flaws, plus missing hosting, privacy pages and licence.
